verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only developer building blocks: REST APIs, language SDKs, a CreateTransaction endpoint and an MCP server. One general claim says tax logic applies consistently across ecommerce, marketplace, POS and ERP systems, but it never documents prebuilt, maintained connectors to billing systems, payment processors or commerce platforms that feed transactions in without custom plumbing. SDKs and APIs are primitives for building the integration, not the integration itself, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, there are maintained integrations for my revenue stack — billing systems, payment processors, and commerce platforms feed transactions in without me building the plumbing
